name: plugin.context_course_bridge
description: Hugging Face Context Engineering Bridge: 6-layer stack auditor, FastMCP validator, subagent swarm planner, and sandboxed Nano Harness ReAct loop
author: Brain Harness

entrypoints.name: audit_context_surface
entrypoints.description: Audit a project workspace against the 6-layer context engineering stack (Skills, MCP, Plugins, Subagents, Hooks, Nano Harness)

parameters.name: project_dir
parameters.description: Path to the project workspace directory to audit

entrypoints.name: run_nano_harness
entrypoints.description: Execute a sandboxed, path-confined minimal ReAct agentic step loop

parameters.name: task
parameters.description: The objective task for the agent

parameters.name: workspace_root
parameters.description: Path to the sandboxed workspace root

parameters.name: max_steps
parameters.description: Maximum number of ReAct loop steps

entrypoints.name: verify_context_snippets
entrypoints.description: Parse and syntax-validate all fenced code snippets in markdown instructions

parameters.name: markdown_text
parameters.description: Markdown text or documentation content to verify

entrypoints.name: plan_subagent_topology
entrypoints.description: Plan optimal subagent coordination topology using the 10+ files heuristic

parameters.name: files_count
parameters.description: Number of files within the task scope

parameters.name: task_type
parameters.description: Type of task: general, review, refactor, or audit
